## Context / Problem
A plan edited mid-review still runs every remaining LLM pass and only fails at sign time — `generation.sign_manifest` re-collects the generation and raises `PlanReviewGenerationChanged` when `fresh.own_material != initial_generation.own_material` (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/generation.py:146-170). Everything billed after the edit is pure waste: Pass-1 checkpoints are keyed by the material fingerprint (`sizing._checkpoint_key`, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/sizing.py:495-517), so no completed chunk survives the edit either. The sign-time equality was deliberately narrowed to own material + pinned related material — `relation_snapshot` and `ticket_store_revision` are `compare=False` (generation.py:24-41; commit 7c3c08df8 / bug d70a: store-wide equality aborted signing on unrelated tickets' writes). The cancel predicate must be scoped the same way (OWN material only) or it reintroduces d70a as false mid-run cancels.

Since B-RETIRE the sole review driver is the v3 workflow `gates/plan-review.yaml` run by `gate_dispatch.produce_plan_review_verdict` (src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py:111-241): precheck → assemble → finders (`batch` → `pass1.run_pass1`) → prerequisite verify → grounding → verify_branch{verify_inputs → verify → decide → coach_inputs → coach}. Two executor facts shape the mechanism: (a) a scripted-op exception is captured as a failed StepResult (src/rebar/llm/workflow/interpreter.py:498-499) and `rc.failed` short-circuits every remaining step (interpreter.py:319) — it does NOT propagate; (b) gate_dispatch then tries the coach/verify recovery reconstructions (gate_dispatch.py:218-232), so a cancel that looks like a mere step failure would be "recovered" into a findings verdict and flow on to the floors, signing, and `sidecar.emit` (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py:599-728) — and a sidecar write advances the store revision. The cancel signal must therefore be an out-of-band token that produce_plan_review_verdict checks BEFORE its recovery paths.

## Approach
(1) `generation.py` grows the run-scoped cancel token + probe (no new module):
- `PlanReviewCancelledStale(RuntimeError)`.
- a private `ContextVar` holding a `_CancelScope` dataclass `{ticket_id, baseline_own_material, repo_root, event: threading.Event}`, entered via `@contextmanager cancel_scope(...)`; `review_cancelled() -> bool` reads it None-safely.
- `own_material_changed(ticket_id, baseline, *, repo_root) -> bool`: under `ticket_reads.local_read_context()` (src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py:169-176 — makes `ensure_fresh` at reads.py:193-210 return before any fetch/reconverge or sync-lock acquisition) call `attest.current_material_fingerprint(ticket_id, repo_root=repo_root)` (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest.py:756-791 — a single-ticket light read: `show_ticket` + child ids, no store-wide reduction). Returns True only when baseline and current are both non-None and differ; unknown/None → False (fail-open; monotone — a missed cancel degrades to today's sign-time refusal).
- `probe_cancel(seam)`: no active scope → no-op; if the event is already set, or `own_material_changed(...)` is True → `event.set()` + raise `PlanReviewCancelledStale`. It NEVER compares tracker HEAD, the relation snapshot, or `related_material` (d70a scoping; dependency drift keeps its reusable checkpoints and is still caught at sign time).

(2) Probe placement — exactly the two between-pass seams, as one call at the top of the ops that already run there in BOTH `verify_branch` arms: `plan_review_verify_inputs` (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/workflow_ops.py:365 — after the finders batch, before the Pass-2 verify prompt step) and `plan_review_coach_inputs` (workflow_ops.py:414 — after decide, before the Pass-4 coach prompt step). No per-chunk polling, no new yaml steps, no whole-store reads.

(3) `pass1._chunk` (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/pass1.py:479-498) first checks `generation.review_cancelled()` and returns `([], [])` without a runner call or checkpoint I/O — the ContextVar reaches pool workers because `_submit_ctx` submits under `copy_context()` (pass1.py:67-75). Defensive in the two-seam design (the event cannot be set mid-finders today) but it makes the funnel safe for any future seam at one Event-read of cost. In-flight `runner.run` calls are not interruptible — up to pool-width in-flight calls are accepted as sunk cost.

(4) `gate_dispatch.produce_plan_review_verdict`: compute `baseline = orchestrator.material_fingerprint(ctx)` (the identical hash `initial_generation.own_material` carries — pass1.py:727-744) and add `generation.cancel_scope(...)` to the existing with-stack (gate_dispatch.py:179-184). Wrap `run_workflow` so a `PlanReviewCancelledStale` escaping the batch step is also caught (`_run_batch` calls `runner.run(req, rc.runner)` with no try — interpreter.py:399 — so batch exceptions propagate raw, unlike op exceptions). After the run, BEFORE the coach/verify recovery attempts: if the scope's event is set, return a cancelled verdict built with `claimability.indeterminate_verdict` (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/claimability.py:123-167) — finding id `plan-review-cancelled-stale`, `coverage_extra={"cancelled": {"seam": ..., "reason": ...}}`, `signature_reason="cancelled-stale"`, remediation "the ticket's own plan material changed mid-review; everything after the edit was skipped — rerun `rebar review-plan`".

(5) `__init__._run_plan_review`: immediately after the `produce_plan_review_verdict` call (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py:599-607), if `verdict["coverage"].get("cancelled")` return the verdict verbatim — skipping the floors, `attest.sign_plan_review`, and `sidecar.emit`, mirroring the not-claimable early return (__init__.py:476-479). The verdict is unsigned INDETERMINATE with `sidecar_emitted: False`; the CLI maps INDETERMINATE to exit 2 (src/rebar/_cli/_llm_commands.py:443,535). Monotone safety: the cancel path can only WITHHOLD an attestation (it returns before any signing code), never mint one.

Alternatives rejected: keying on tracker HEAD / the relation snapshot, or per-chunk `generation.collect()` polling — a store-wide reduction that can contend for the sync lock and false-cancels on unrelated writes (the exact d70a regression); cancelling on `related_material` drift — that discards reusable fingerprint-keyed checkpoints and sign-time already refuses it.

## Scope
src/rebar/llm/plan_review/generation.py, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/pass1.py, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/workflow_ops.py, src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py, tests/unit/workflow/test_plan_review_cancel.py. Out of scope: the yaml (unchanged), the bespoke orchestrator (retired), verify-completion/code-review gates, any cancellation of in-flight runner calls.

## Testing
New tests/unit/workflow/test_plan_review_cancel.py on the existing offline harness (the `_patch_reads` / `_CountingFinder` / `_CannedAgent` pattern of tests/unit/workflow/test_plan_review_workflow.py:49-183, driven through `gate_dispatch.produce_plan_review_verdict` as in tests/unit/test_gate_engine_cutover.py:90):
- post-finders cancel: `attest.current_material_fingerprint` patched to flip after the first finder call → the verify/coach prompt steps never run (agent-runner call recording), the verdict is INDETERMINATE carrying the `plan-review-cancelled-stale` finding, `signature.signed` is False, `sidecar_emitted` is False, and `review_plan`'s CLI disposition is exit 2.
- post-decide cancel: fingerprint flips after decide → coach never runs, same cancelled verdict shape.
- d70a guard: a mid-run write to a DIFFERENT ticket (the subject's own fingerprint unchanged) does NOT cancel — the run completes to the same PASS as an undisturbed run.
- freshness: the probe never fetches/reconverges — `ensure_fresh`'s sync machinery (patched to record) is not reached from a probe because the read runs under `local_read_context`.
- no-change byte-identity: with the cancel plumbing active and no mid-run edit, the produced verdict for fixed canned inputs equals the pre-change baseline verdict; the existing plan-review suites stay green.
- `_chunk` guard: with the scope's event pre-set, the pooled chunk funnel makes zero runner calls and serves no checkpoints.
- monotone/fail-open: a probe whose fingerprint read returns None (read error) does not cancel; the run proceeds to sign-time behavior.

Gates: `make lint && make typecheck && pytest tests/unit/workflow/` then the full `pytest tests/unit`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] An own-material change observed at either seam cancels the review: INDETERMINATE, exit 2, no signature, no sidecar write, and the downstream verify/coach prompt steps are never invoked (checked: unit tests with call recording at both seams).
- [ ] A mid-run write to an unrelated ticket does NOT cancel, and related-material drift alone does NOT cancel (checked: d70a guard unit test comparing against an undisturbed run).
- [ ] The probe performs no fetch/reconverge and takes no sync lock (checked: unit test asserting the ensure_fresh sync path is never reached from a probe).
- [ ] With no mid-run change, review behavior and outputs are unchanged (checked: byte-identical verdict for fixed canned inputs in the offline harness + existing plan-review tests pass).
- [ ] The cancelled path can never sign or emit a sidecar: it returns before `attest.sign_plan_review` and `sidecar.emit` are reachable (checked: unit test asserting neither is called on a cancelled run).
